description: Follow a prepared plan after the user signs it, e.g. 'I sent the commit, what now?'. Give the plan handle and the hashes of the transactions sent so far, each with its step (none before signing). Returns each step's state (confirmed, pending, reverted, waiting, ready or blocked), the registration commitment's window, whether the next step would succeed now and what to do next. Once every step is confirmed it names the tool that shows the result.
